note: Every runtime asset is original and procedural (SVG / CSS / Three.js / Canvas). The katana collection uses shared live geometry for Home, gameplay and catalog previews; museum and game development references are documented in docs/research-2026-09-12-katana-collection.md. No external art was imported.

assets.purpose: The resin block face used by the board, tray, drag visual, shop previews and tutorial diagrams
assets.construction: Layered CSS: restrained face gradient (+14 % white top → −4 % black bottom), four-sided bevel from inset shadows (top+left lit 42 % white with a 1 px 65 % catch-light, right 26 % black, bottom 22 % black), bottom lip (14 % + 34 % underline), contact shadow, 24 %-height gloss (::before), faint resin glow (::after). Colour from --tone; radius 0.17 cell, bevel 5.5 % cell (min 1.5 px), lip 7.5 % cell.

assets.purpose: Smoked ceramic frame, near-black grooves, recessed tile faces, glass mirror column with a slow travelling reflection
assets.construction: Frame #181b20 with inset highlight and outer shadow; grid background #0f1216; each cell ::before is a #24282f face with top highlight and bottom shade; axis cells use #353940 plus a gradient sheen animated 9s.

assets.purpose: The signature katana: gameplay blade dock, Home hero, Shop blade preview
assets.construction: Five designs in src/config/katanas.ts: Shoshin, Kage, Shiosai, Raimei, Akatsuki. Each has a 128-ring / 12-vertex curved steel blade, distinct vertex-color hamon, tapered tip, curved edge highlight, habaki with divisions, paired seppa, original round/lobed/floral pierced guard and raised rim, fuchi/kashira, conforming crossed silk ribbons over textured samé, two-sided menuki and higher-tier inlays. Geometry batched into at most eight material meshes, shared across screen mounts. Seeded steel grain, silk weave and underlay textures; studio environment. Full and fittings inspection views.
assets.dimensions: ≈ 5.2 scene units long; 10,612 / 11,508 / 12,180 / 12,176 / 14,740 triangles; 256×1024 steel, 128×128 silk, 128×512 samé textures

assets.purpose: Soft contact shadow under the hero / preview blade
assets.construction: 128×64 canvas radial gradient, squashed to an ellipse, used as a transparent plane texture

assets.purpose: Every UI glyph: home, play, pause, restart, settings, shop, collection, stats, achievements, daily, back, close, confirm, info, sound, music, haptics, graphics, motion, contrast, shard (currency), blade, rotate, lock, owned, equipped, howto, share, mirror, energy, overdrive, fracture, clutch, chain, crest, trail, effect, board, blocks, time
assets.construction: 24×24 SVG, 1.75px round-capped strokes, 18–20px optical silhouette. Only the crest, shard, play and equipped star are solid fills.

assets.purpose: Score emblem in the HUD, Home records, results and Perfection medallion
assets.construction: Original three-point crest with a base bar; gold #ecb455 with a soft drop shadow. Drawn as its own silhouette rather than copied from the reference crown.

assets.purpose: Corner crack marks that appear during Fracture and shatter outward on a timeout
assets.construction: One SVG crack path mirrored into four corners, 22vmin each, cold blue during Fracture, coral in the final seconds

assets.purpose: Line-clear sweeps, particles, rings, placement wake and cut sparks
assets.construction: Pooled Canvas 2D particles (square / dot / shard) with gravity and spin, gradient sweeps per cleared line, expanding rings for ripple / strong clears. Style and colours come from the equipped clear effect and trail.

assets.purpose: Embossed circle / triangle / square / diamond on each tone in colour-accessible mode
assets.construction: Four 24×24 stroke-only SVG data URIs at 45% black, 46% of the block size

assets.purpose: All sound effects and the base / chain / overdrive / fracture music layers
assets.construction: Web Audio oscillators with exponential envelopes; three sound themes alter pitch, decay and waveforms

assets.purpose: Distant drifting piece silhouettes, motes, rare katana pass behind every screen
assets.construction: Canvas 2D at ~30 fps: rounded-rect piece silhouettes from the piece library at 4–9 % alpha on three parallax depths, 10–22 motes, a gradient line that sweeps through one piece every 15–35 s and splits it into two drifting halves. Pointer parallax on desktop only; static under reduced motion; off at Low quality.

assets.purpose: Shop and Collection item cards for blade skins
assets.construction: Original SVG overviews using the model's blade-section, hamon and guard-contour functions, with matching fittings, crossing wrap, menuki and finish gradients. Ordered 01–05 cards remain fully visible when unaffordable.

assets.purpose: Individual Home and catalog signature animation with an explicit still hold
assets.construction: Silver glint, moon crescent, tide ribbons, storm branches or sun halo/rays; pooled line and point buffers plus a glint plane, at most three effect draw calls. Deterministic 2.2–3.4 s flourish followed by 3–3.3 s still hold. Replay and pause controls, static reduced-motion view, hidden-tab gating. Effects are not shown over gameplay.

assets.purpose: DOUBLE / TRIPLE / MAX / PERFECT / CLUTCH / CONTRACT / PRECISION / MIRROR LEVEL words
assets.construction: Text with background-clip metal gradients per tier, per-letter compress/expand, one-pass sheen, axis-outward clip-path reveal, scaleY(−1) masked reflection
